task: Grade a migration briefing covering vLLM v0.29.0 and Transformers v5.17.0. Only one release per project is supplied, so integration facts compare these release versions without implying a same-project upgrade history.

nuggets.text: vLLM v0.29.0 makes Model Runner V2 the default for all models, while retaining MRV1 fallback for some ROCm models and features MRV2 does not yet support.
vLLM v0.29.0 deprecates MRV1 and targets its removal for v0.32; removal is planned, not completed.

vLLM v0.29.0 removes Arctic, Chameleon, Cheers, Fairseq2Llama, FireRedLID, GritLM, HCXVision, MPT, the RWForCausalLM and StableLMEpochForCausalLM aliases, and PrithviGeoSpatialMAE; Terratorch supersedes PrithviGeoSpatialMAE.
vLLM v0.29.0 moves FlexOlmo, Olmo3, Hunyuan V1 and Hunyuan VL from native implementations to the Transformers modeling backend.
vLLM v0.29.0 removes the PyAV video decoder backend; users should migrate to OpenCV or Torchcodec.
vLLM v0.29.0 deprecates python -m vllm.entrypoints.openai.api_server in favor of vllm serve.
vLLM v0.29.0 exposes prefix_cache_retention_interval as a CLI argument and deprecates its environment-variable configuration.
vLLM v0.29.0 changes the prefix_cache_retention_interval default from dense retention to 0 for SWA/SSM models; dense retention is automatically restored for hybrid models using EAGLE/MTP.
vLLM v0.29.0 enables FlashInfer all-reduce by default for TP CUDA groups; VLLM_ALLREDUCE_USE_FLASHINFER=0 opts out.
vLLM v0.29.0 removes VLLM_TEST_FORCE_FP8_MARLIN in favor of the --linear-backend and --moe-backend controls.
vLLM v0.29.0 makes prefix-cache NONE_HASH deterministic by default, eliminating the need for distributed KV cache users to pin PYTHONHASHSEED.
vLLM v0.29.0 adds Hy4-preview support with native multi-token prediction, or MTP.
vLLM v0.29.0 can include per-request speculative-decoding acceptance statistics in OpenAI API responses through --per-request-spec-decode-metrics.
Transformers v5.17.0 centralizes 2D/3D vision RoPE computation in modeling_rope_utils.py; custom vision models relying on attention-layer or model-specific grid interleaving must migrate.
Transformers v5.17.0 adds HYV4/Hy4-Preview support but does not execute its MTP layers; their checkpoint weights are ignored at load time.
Transformers v5.17.0 adds KimiLinear, using Kimi Delta Attention in most layers and a full-attention MLA block every fourth layer.
Transformers v5.17.0 adds VibeVoice for long-form, multi-speaker speech synthesis using next-token diffusion within an LLM structure.
Transformers v5.17.0 adds NeoMME-Retriever, which produces both multi-vector late-interaction embeddings and mean-pooled dense embeddings for document retrieval.
Transformers v5.17.0 avoids unnecessary accelerator synchronization on every generation decode step, reducing per-step overhead.
Transformers v5.17.0 raises an error when a paged-attention forward pass is called without a cache, addressing a silent failure.

integration_facts.text: Hy4-Preview model support does not imply equal MTP capability across runtimes: vLLM v0.29.0 supports native MTP, whereas Transformers v5.17.0 ignores the checkpoint's MTP weights and does not execute those layers.

Hunyuan compatibility changes at both the serving and configuration layers: vLLM v0.29.0 moves Hunyuan V1/VL to the Transformers modeling backend, while Transformers v5.17.0 normalizes HunYuanVL legacy field aliases through attribute_map. The notes do not establish a minimum Transformers version for that vLLM migration.

Both releases reduce inference synchronization overhead at different execution points: vLLM v0.29.0 MRV2 skips DP synchronization before EAGLE/MTP draft prefill, while Transformers v5.17.0 avoids unnecessary accelerator synchronization on every generation decode step.

Both releases refine hidden-state handling for speculative or MTP workflows: vLLM v0.29.0 adds MRV2 support for extract_hidden_states speculation, while Transformers v5.17.0 saves MTP memory by capturing only the last layer's hidden_states.

Both releases improve low-bit execution on Intel XPU through different mechanisms: vLLM v0.29.0 adds an INC int4 W4A8 linear backend and AutoRound MXFP8 MoE support, while Transformers v5.17.0 avoids unnecessary MXFP4 weight dequantization when use_kernels is enabled.

Kernel customization uses explicit, runtime-specific controls across these releases: vLLM v0.29.0 replaces VLLM_TEST_FORCE_FP8_MARLIN with --linear-backend/--moe-backend, while Transformers v5.17.0 extends KernelConfig to register standalone functions such as RoPE and optionally avoid inheriting default mappings.

answer_key.q: What changes about vLLM's default model runner, and when is MRV1 removal planned?
answer_key.a: v0.29.0 defaults to MRV2, with MRV1 fallback for unsupported features and some ROCm models. MRV1 is deprecated, with removal targeted for v0.32.

answer_key.q: What replaces vLLM's deprecated server launch command and removed PyAV decoder?
answer_key.a: Use vllm serve instead of python -m vllm.entrypoints.openai.api_server, and OpenCV or Torchcodec instead of PyAV.

answer_key.q: How does prefix_cache_retention_interval change in vLLM v0.29.0?
answer_key.a: Use the CLI argument instead of the deprecated environment variable. SWA/SSM defaults change from dense retention to 0, with dense retention automatically restored for hybrid EAGLE/MTP models.

answer_key.q: What must custom vision models migrate in Transformers v5.17.0?
answer_key.a: Move attention-layer or model-specific 2D/3D RoPE grid interleaving to the centralized modeling_rope_utils.py implementation.

answer_key.q: Does Hy4-Preview execute MTP in both supplied releases?
answer_key.a: vLLM v0.29.0 supports native MTP. Transformers v5.17.0 ignores MTP checkpoint weights and does not execute the MTP layers.

answer_key.q: Which all-reduce implementation becomes the vLLM default, and how can users opt out?
answer_key.a: FlashInfer all-reduce becomes the default for TP CUDA groups in v0.29.0. Set VLLM_ALLREDUCE_USE_FLASHINFER=0 to opt out.
